record.field: Draft a chatter reply for the pinned record and open the mail composer wizard pre-filled with the draft.

Draft a chatter message and open the mail composer wizard pre-filled with the draft. Do NOT post the message — leave it for the user to review and send from the wizard. 1. Resolve the target record from the pinned record in `` (model + id). If still missing, call `ask_user` once for a record reference. 2. Decide what the reply should say: - If the user already wrote the message text in their request (the prompt after `/reply ...` reads like a finished sentence to a recipient), use that text almost verbatim and just rewrap it as short HTML paragraphs. - If the user only gave a directive (e.g. "thank them for the quick turnaround", "ask when shipping"), ground the draft: `search_read` on `mail.message` with domain `[('model','=',),('res_id','=',),('message_type','in',['comment','email'])]`, order `date desc`, limit 3, fields `date,subject,body,author_id`. Then write a tactful 60–90 word reply that follows the directive and references the most recent prior message concretely. If there is no prior message, open with a short re-introduction. 3. Wrap the draft as minimal HTML — `

…

` paragraphs only. No inline styles, no signature (Odoo appends one). 4. Call `open_action`: - `action_ref`: `mail.action_email_compose_message_wizard` - `additional_context`: - `default_model`: target model - `default_res_ids`: `[]` - `default_composition_mode`: `comment` - `default_subtype_xmlid`: `mail.mt_comment` - `default_body`: the HTML draft 5. Reply with one short confirmation line, e.g. `Drafted reply to ; review and send it from the composer.` Stop. Do not post the message yourself.
